newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end off on Telebras worries.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end off on Telebras worries.

text.p: Brazil shares ended off 0.9 percent on continued speculative selling of benchmark Telebras preferred shares following a court ruling on Wednesday, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 42 most traded shares closed down 598 points at 65,888 points. Turnover was heavy at 534.5 million reais ($521.2 million).

Power firm Eletrobras preferred shares ended up 3.86 percent at 350 reais. Mining giant Vale do Rio Doce preferred shares closed at 21.30 reais, up 1.43 percent. Oil monopoly Petrobras preferred shares closed flat at 130 reais.
Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index comprising nine most liquid stocks of the electrical sector (IEE) rose 0.64 percent to close at 1,818 points, a bourse spokeswoman said.
